mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'
# TLS backend

No decision on the TLS backend is currently recorded for this project. Until one is recorded, this document does not specify a TLS backend.

cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-backend.md`. It says that no TLS backend decision is currently recorded for this project.

The catalog and `muninn why` have no decision or rule about the TLS backend. The only TLS mentions are two unlinked, trust-1 session excerpts that name different backends (OpenSSL and rustls), neither promoted to a decision. So I didn't pick a value or name either one in the file.

The catalog does list "https everywhere, no exceptions" and "verification on all builds". These don't say which TLS backend to use, so I left them out.

Muninn also shows a heartbeat warning: 20 hook runs started and never finished. That may mean a hook is timing out, and it could affect how complete the records are.
